title: Provider Manual Note: Weeks Counted in a Prior Authorization Extension Request
content:
The weeks of a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension request follow how close the authorization is to its current end date and what is left on it.

## Rule

1. Where the current end date is no more than **14 days** after the day of the request and the units remaining on the authorization are no more than the class's weekly frequency cap, the weeks are counted from the day of the request to the end date asked for: the days from the day of the request to the current end date plus the class's extension days, divided by seven and rounded down.
2. Where the current end date is no more than 14 days after the day of the request but the units remaining exceed the weekly frequency cap, the weeks are the whole weeks of the class's extension days less one week, the week that the remaining units cover. The whole weeks of the extension days are the extension days divided by seven and rounded down.
3. Otherwise — where the current end date is more than 14 days after the day of the request — the weeks are the whole weeks of the class's extension days.

The days to the current end date are counted from the day of the request forward to that date. A current end date that has already passed is also no more than 14 days after the day of the request; the days past it are then taken away from the extension days instead of added to them.

## Reading the fourteen-day line

| Days from the request to the current end date | Units remaining compared with the weekly cap | Weeks |
|---|---|---|
| 14 or fewer | no more than the cap | days to the end date plus extension days, divided by seven, rounded down |
| 14 or fewer | more than the cap | whole weeks of the extension days, less one |
| 15 or more | any | whole weeks of the extension days |

## Worked cases (hypothetical class with 60 extension days and a weekly frequency cap of 3 units)

- Current end date 14 days away, 3 units remaining: 14 plus 60 is 74; seventy-four divided by seven is ten and four sevenths, so 10 weeks.
- Current end date 14 days away, 4 units remaining: eight whole weeks of extension days less one gives 7 weeks.
- Current end date 15 days away, any units remaining: 8 weeks.
- Current end date passed 3 days before the request, 2 units remaining: 60 less 3 is 57; fifty-seven divided by seven is eight and one seventh, so 8 weeks.
